title: Extract the duplicated expired-pending-begin settlement into one helper
outcome: The expired-pending-begin withdrawal and fresh-admission settlement lives in one helper in engram_begin_preparation_retry.rs, used at both sites: the start of the attempt and the send boundary. engram_host_adapter.rs no longer carries two copies that could drift apart. The behaviour is unchanged.
acceptance: The expired-pending-begin withdrawal and fresh-admission settlement is implemented once, in a helper outside engram_host_adapter.rs, and both call sites (the start of the attempt and the send boundary) use it; engram_host_adapter.rs keeps no duplicated copy.

Behaviour is unchanged: the expired-grant tests (src/tests/engram_begin_expired_grant.rs, including the send-boundary test) and the rest of the root_dispatch, begin_boot, admission_budget and recovery_format tests pass on the frozen input, as they did on the w-34ec freeze it stacks on.
The full gate is green on the frozen input.
The review pair (Codex and Claude, read-only) has no outstanding Medium-or-higher finding on the frozen input.
